svg.text: nothing before its colon beyond the
RUN ON THE ROWS, AT EVERY HOST
The master builds the four inputs on Navier–Stokes, Yang–Mills, Hodge, BSD and Poincaré at every host, and on Goldbach, and the method returns all seven
conclusions on each; where the calm and the counter frame share one record, no predicate of the record decides the value.
